## One-time Database Schema Setup

Run this workflow ONCE (manually) before the RAG ingestion and main support-agent workflows.

It creates the pgvector extension and all shared tables:
`customers`, `conversations`, `messages`, `support_tickets`, `orders`, `knowledge_documents`, `knowledge_chunks`, `support_logs`, and the `n8n_chat_histories` memory table.

All statements are idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS / ON CONFLICT), so re-running is safe. Embeddings use `vector(1536)` for OpenAI text-embedding-3-small.

parameters.query:
-- ==========================================================
-- AI Customer Support Automation - Database Schema Setup
-- Idempotent: safe to re-run. Run ONCE before the other
-- two workflows (RAG ingestion + main support agent).
-- ==========================================================

-- pgvector extension for embeddings
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

-- Customers
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
  customer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name        TEXT,
  email       TEXT,
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Conversations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (
  conversation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id     TEXT,
  status          TEXT DEFAULT 'open',
  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Messages (full conversation history)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
  id              BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id     TEXT,
  conversation_id TEXT,
  role            TEXT,
  message         TEXT,
  timestamp       TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Support tickets (created on escalation / explicit ticket creation)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS support_tickets (
  ticket_id       BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id     TEXT,
  conversation_id TEXT,
  issue           TEXT,
  reason          TEXT,
  status          TEXT DEFAULT 'open',
  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Orders (looked up by the agent's order tools)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
  order_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id TEXT,
  status      TEXT,
  total       NUMERIC,
  items       JSONB,
  updated_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Knowledge base: source documents
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_documents (
  document_id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  title       TEXT,
  category    TEXT,
  source      TEXT,
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Knowledge base: embedded chunks (pgvector). 1536 dims = text-embedding-3-small
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_chunks (
  id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  document_id BIGINT,
  chunk_text  TEXT,
  embedding   vector(1536),
  metadata    JSONB,
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Structured application logs (per request)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS support_logs (
  id              BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id     TEXT,
  conversation_id TEXT,
  intent          TEXT,
  retrieved_docs  JSONB,
  tools_used      JSONB,
  response        TEXT,
  escalated       BOOLEAN,
  ticket_id       BIGINT,
  errors          TEXT,
  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- n8n Postgres Chat Memory table (safety net; the memory node also
-- auto-creates this if missing). Used as short-term conversation buffer.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS n8n_chat_histories (
  id         SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  session_id VARCHAR(255),
  message    JSONB
);

-- Helpful indexes for history + lookups
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_conversation ON messages (conversation_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_customer ON orders (customer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunks_document ON knowledge_chunks (document_id);

-- Example seed data so downstream workflows can be verified end-to-end
INSERT INTO customers (customer_id, name, email) VALUES
  ('CUST-1001', 'Ada Lovelace', 'ada@example.com'),
  ('CUST-1002', 'Alan Turing',  'alan@example.com')
ON CONFLICT (customer_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO orders (order_id, customer_id, status, total, items) VALUES
  ('ORD-5001', 'CUST-1001', 'shipped',   129.99, '[{"sku":"WIDGET-1","qty":2}]'),
  ('ORD-5002', 'CUST-1001', 'processing', 49.50, '[{"sku":"GADGET-9","qty":1}]'),
  ('ORD-5003', 'CUST-1002', 'delivered',  15.00, '[{"sku":"CABLE-3","qty":3}]')
ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING;
